svg.title: One request, three processes, one block pool
svg.desc: A chat request crosses the API server, the engine core, and a GPU worker, drawn as machines on one bench. The API server tokenizes, the engine core holds the Scheduler and the KVCacheManager with its grid of blocks, and the GPU worker runs GPUModelRunner on the NVIDIA L4. With 8 users and Qwen3-8B, 87.2 percent of the prompt tokens came from cached 16-token blocks of a 24,096-token pool. Below, towers show the median time to first token with the prefix cache on and off at 256, 1,024, and 2,048 shared tokens.
svg.text: ONE REQUEST THROUGH VLLM 0.31.0 ON OUR L4
